notes: SEQN is the unique participant identifier; maps to person_source_value to link all records to the same individual.
Dietary day one sample weight is a survey weight, not a clinical measurement. Stored as an observation with a custom concept for the weight type.
Dietary two-day sample weight is a survey weight, stored similarly to WTDRD1 as an observation.
Dietary recall status is a categorical variable indicating completeness/quality of recall. Maps to observation with a concept for recall status.
Interviewer ID code is an identifier for the interviewer, not a standard concept. Stored as observation text or in provider table if interviewers are treated as providers.
Breast-fed infant indicator is a binary observation. Could map to a standard concept for infant feeding status.
Number of days of intake is an ordinal count. Stored as numeric observation.
Days between intake and HH interview is a continuous numeric value, stored as observation.
Intake day of the week is categorical; maps to observation with a concept for day of week.

How often add salt to food at table is ordinal; maps to observation with a concept for frequency.
Salt used in preparation is ordinal; maps to observation with a concept for salt use frequency.
